SELECT *
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'https://nicdatalake11.dfs.core.windows.net/data/ActivityLog01.parquet',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
)AS [mytable]
WHERE STATUS='Started'


SELECT COUNT(*) AS [StartedCount]
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'https://nicdatalake11.dfs.core.windows.net/data/ActivityLog01.parquet',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS [mytable]
WHERE [STATUS] = 'Started';
